blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Thinking with images (TwI) empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to overcome perceptual bottlenecks by actively cropping and zooming into fine-grained visual details, promising both higher accuracy and interpretable, region-grounded reasoning. However, our analysis shows that the improved accuracy of TwI models does not guarantee faithful tool use; they frequently invoke tools without actually relying on the zoomed region, undermining the reliability of tool-assisted reasoning. We trace this unfaithful behaviour to the training data: when questions are answerable without zooming, the model can answer correctly while ignoring the returned evidence, and this problem is exacerbated during training as the model becomes better at answering without tools. To keep zooming useful throughout training, we adapt the training data to the model's evolving capability and train on questions where correct zoomed evidence can still help the model answer correctly. This selection is supported by a data synthesis pipeline that localises small objects and constructs verifiable questions about their fine details, and complemented by an adaptiveness reward that favours tool-free answers when zooming is unnecessary. The experimental results show that our method substantially improves reasoning faithfulness and achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual search benchmarks (+11.6% on V*, +7.9% on HR-Bench 4K, and +9.4% on HR-Bench 8K). On multimodal hallucination benchmarks, our model also outperforms the compared TwI baselines. These results suggest that improving TwI faithfulness does not sacrifice accuracy and that both can be learnt from the right training data without directly supervising the reasoning process.
blocks.zh: 用图像思考(TwI)可以增强视觉语言模型(VLMs)的能力,通过积极裁剪和放大精细的视觉细节来克服知觉瓶颈,同时保证更高的准确度和可解释的,基于区域的推理. 然而,我们的分析表明,TwI模型精度的提高并不能保证忠实工具的使用;它们经常引用工具而不实际依赖放大区域,破坏了工具辅助推理的可靠性. 我们追踪这种不诚实的行为到训练数据:当问题解答而不缩放时,模型可以正确回答,同时忽略返回的证据,随着模型在没有工具的情况下更善于回答,这个问题在训练期间变得更加严重. 为了在整个培训中保持放大效果,我们根据模型不断发展的能力调整培训数据,并对正确放大的证据仍然能帮助模型正确回答的问题进行培训。 这一选择得到了数据合成管道的支持,该管道将小物体定位,并构建关于其细微细节的可核查问题,并辅以适应性奖励,在不需要缩放时有利于无工具答案. 实验结果显示,我们的方法大大提高了推理的忠诚度,实现了视觉搜索基准(V*+11.6%,HR-Bench 4K+7.9%,HR-Bench 8K+9.4%)的先进性能. 在多式联运幻觉基准方面,我们的模型也超过了比较的TwI基线。 这些结果表明,提高TwI的忠诚度不会牺牲准确性,而且两者都可以从正确的培训数据中学习,而不直接监督推理过程。

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) often struggle to recognise small objects, dense text, and fine-grained spatial relationships from an image [ 15 , 2 , 61 ] .
Thinking with images [ 26 , TwI;] mitigates this perceptual bottleneck by enabling VLMs to act as multimodal agents that actively crop and zoom into regions of interest and perform interleaved reasoning on the text and zoomed images [ 26 , 61 , 33 , 10 , 15 , 56 , 9 ] .
Beyond improving answer accuracy, TwI facilitates explainable, region-grounded question answering, where each zoomed image provides explicit visual evidence intended to support the model’s prediction.
However, this explainability holds only when the model faithfully interprets the images returned by its tools. [ 21 , 7 , 31 , 44 , 54 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh:
视觉-语言模型(VLMs)经常会挣扎着从图像中识别出小物体,密集的文字,和精细的纹理空间关系[15,2,61].
与图像相思[26,TwI;]通过使VLM发挥多模式代理作用,积极收成并放大到感兴趣的区域,并在文本上进行互断推理并放大图像[26,61,33,10,15,56,9]来缓解这一认知瓶颈.
除了提高答案的准确性外,TwI还促进可解释的、基于区域的回答,每个放大的图像提供明确的视觉证据,旨在支持模型的预测。
然而,只有当模型忠实地解释其工具返回的图像时,这种解释性才有效。 [21、7、31、44、54、19]。

blocks.en:
In this work, we first examine the faithfulness of TwI models: a model is faithful if it generates reasoning traces and outputs consistent with the content of the zoomed images.
For example, a faithful model should accurately recognise the objects in the zoomed images without hallucinating objects that are not present.
Faithfulness is thus distinct from answer accuracy: a model that zooms into the wrong region can still behave faithfully, while a correct answer can be based on an unsupported visual claim.
We audit the outputs of DeepEyes [ 61 ] , PixelReasoner [ 33 ] , and CodeV [ 10 ] and identify two distinct faithfulness failure modes ( Figure 1 ).
Specifically, DeepEyes and PixelReasoner frequently claim to see objects that are absent from a zoomed image in 98.8 % 98.8\% of instances.
Conversely, CodeV does not recognise objects that are visible in the zoomed region in 87.9 % 87.9\% of instances, even though CodeV aims to improve faithfulness by training the model to zoom into the correct region [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们首先检查了TwI模型的忠实性:一个模型如果产生与被放大的图像内容相符合的推理痕迹和输出,那么它是忠实的.
例如,忠实的模型应该准确识别被放大的图像中的物体,而不会产生不存在的幻觉物体.
因此信得过与答的准确性是不同的:一个被放大到错误区域的模式仍然可以忠实地表现,而正确的答案可以基于一个没有支持的视觉诉求.
我们审计DeepEyes[61]、PixelReasoner[33]和CodeV[10]的产出,并找出两种不同的忠诚失败模式(图1)。
具体来说,DeepEyes和PixelReasoner经常声称在98.8%的98.8%的案例中看到放大图像中缺失的物体.
反之,代码 V不识别87.9%87.9%的缩放区域可见物体,尽管代码V旨在通过培训模型来将缩放到正确的区域来提高忠诚度[10]。

blocks.en:
To investigate how unfaithful TwI may emerge, we compare model performance with and without tool access and track how this relationship evolves during reinforcement learning (RL) ( Section 2.1 ).
Although DeepEyes, PixelReasoner, and CodeV call tools on over 94 % 94\% of questions, zooming improves their accuracy by at most 3.0 3.0 points and sometimes lowers it ( Figure 3 ).
Moreover, the accuracy of DeepEyes without tools on V* [ 47 ] rises from 71.9 % 71.9\% to 83.3 % 83.3\% during RL training ( Figure 3 ).
These observations suggest a potential source of unfaithful tool use: when training questions can be answered correctly without zooming, outcome-based rewards may reinforce correct answers without requiring the model to interpret the returned visual evidence.
This means that during training, the model can learn to answer questions without relying on the tool, making tool use decorative for those instances.
This leads to our hypothesis that unfaithful tool use may stem from training questions that do not require zooming.
blocks.zh:
为了调查如何出现不忠的TwI,我们比较模型性能与没有工具的存取,并跟踪这种关系在强化学习(RL)过程中如何演变(第2.1节).
尽管DeepEyes, PixelReasoner, 和代码 V调用工具在94%以上的94QQ问题上,缩放在最多3.0分时提高了准确度,有时会降低(图3).
此外,DeepEyes在V*[47]上没有工具的准确性从71.9%的71.9%的71.9%的83.3%的83.3%的RL培训(图3).
这些观察表明使用不忠工具的潜在来源:当培训问题能够在不放大的情况下得到正确答案时,基于结果的奖励可能强化正确的答案而不需要模型解释返回的视觉证据.
这意味着在培训期间,模型可以学会不依赖工具而回答问题,使工具为这些实例使用装饰.
这导致了我们的假设,即不忠实的工具使用可能源于不需要放大的训练问题.

blocks.en:
Building on this hypothesis, we propose adapting the training data to the model’s evolving capabilities.
Specifically, we select questions where providing the correct zoomed evidence improves the current model’s answer accuracy compared with using the whole image alone ( Section 3.2 ).
To support this selection, we build a data synthesis pipeline that uses SAM3 [ 4 ] to localise small objects and a VLM to generate questions about their fine details.
The localised regions also provide the zoomed evidence needed for the data selection method ( Section 3.1 ).
We further introduce an adaptiveness reward that encourages correct tool-free answers when the model can answer reliably without zooming ( Section 3.3 ).
This helps the model use its tool-free answering capability, allowing data selection to better identify questions that benefit from zoomed evidence.
Our experiments show that adaptive data selection and the adaptiveness reward jointly improve answer accuracy and faithfulness ( Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
根据这一假设,我们提议根据模型不断发展的能力调整培训数据。
具体地说,我们选择的问题,如果提供正确的放大证据,可以提高当前模型的答案准确性,而仅使用整个图像(第3.2节)。
为了支持这一选择,我们建造了一个数据合成管道,利用SAM3[4]对小物体进行本地化,以及一个VLM来产生对其细微细节的疑问.
本地化区域还提供了数据选择方法所需的放大证据(第3.1节)。
我们进一步引入适应性奖励,鼓励在模型可以可靠地回答而不缩放时提供正确的无工具答案(第3.3节)。
这有助于模型使用其无工具的解答能力,使数据选择能够更好地识别从被放大的证据中受益的问题.
我们的实验表明,适应性数据选择和适应性奖励共同提高答案的准确性和忠诚性(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate our model FaithTwI on perception-intensive benchmarks that require inspecting fine-grained visual details in high-resolution images.
The experimental results show that based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 2 ] , our method FaithTwI significantly improves the accuracy ( 78.5 % → 90.1 % 78.5\%\rightarrow 90.1\% on V* [ 47 ] , 67.9 % → 77.3 % 67.9\%\rightarrow 77.3\% on HR-Bench 8K [ 42 ] , and 42.6 % → 56.8 % 42.6\%\rightarrow 56.8\% on ZoomBench [ 45 ] ) and achieves state-of-the-art performance.
The audit of the reasoning trace shows that FaithTwI more accurately recognises whether the target is present in the zoomed region, achieving 94.5 % 94.5\% accuracy and surpassing PixelReasoner ( 70.8 % 70.8\% ) and CodeV ( 55.2 % 55.2\% ).
On the multimodal hallucination benchmarks HaloQuest [ 43 ] and VizWiz [ 8 ] , FaithTwI achieves the highest scores among the compared TwI models, reaching 70.7 % 70.7\% and 57.1 % 57.1\% compared with 62.2 % 62.2\% and 54.9 % 54.9\% for CodeV.
These results further suggest that FaithTwI uses the visual evidence more faithfully.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: 1) We analyse how TwI models interpret returned visual evidence, tracing unfaithful tool use to training data that can be answered without zooming ( Section 2 ). 2) We propose a data-driven method to improve accuracy and faithfulness; it adapts the training data to the model’s evolving capability, supported by a question synthesis pipeline and an adaptiveness reward ( Section 3 ). 3) Our experimental results show improvements in both faithfulness and accuracy, with the best accuracy among compared models on visual search and multimodal hallucination benchmarks. ( Section 4 ).

blocks.en: 2.1 Recognising Target Presence and Absence
blocks.zh: 2.1 识别目标存在和缺失

blocks.en:
We test whether a model’s response is consistent with the visual evidence returned by its first tool call on V* [ 47 ] .
To control whether the returned image contains the target, we replace v 1 v_{1} with either a crop centred on the annotated target ( v 1 + v_{1}^{+} ) or a random crop without it ( v 1 − v_{1}^{-} ); we refer to this as the controlled setting in Table 1 .
Then, in the next reasoning turn z 2 z_{2} , we check whether the model claims to see the target when it is present and acknowledges its absence when it is not.
We report the false negative rate (FNR), which represents how often the model claims not to see the target given v 1 + v_{1}^{+} , and the false positive rate (FPR), which represents how often it claims to see the target given v 1 − v_{1}^{-} .
Recognition accuracy (Acc.) is the percentage of crops for which the response correctly identifies whether the target is present.

blocks.en: 2.2 Tool-Free Accuracy Improves During Training
blocks.zh: 2.2 培训期间无工具准确性得到改善

blocks.en:
Comparing evaluation accuracy with and without tools ( Figure 3 ) reveals a mismatch between tool usage and utility.
Although DeepEyes, PixelReasoner, and CodeV invoke tools on nearly all queries ( > 94 % >94\% ), zooming yields modest or even negative returns: DeepEyes drops in accuracy with tools on V* and gains only + 1.4 % +1.4\% on HR-Bench 8K; PixelReasoner gains + 2.6 % +2.6\% on V* but loses − 1.1 % -1.1\% on HR-Bench 8K; and CodeV gains only + 3.0 % +3.0\% and + 1.1 % +1.1\% , respectively.
Recent works also find limited or inconsistent accuracy gains from tool access in TwI [ 44 , 7 ] .

blocks.en:
To trace how this mismatch develops, we replicate DeepEyes training and track its performance across checkpoints ( Figure 3 ).
Remarkably, the model’s tool-free accuracy rises substantially during tool-augmented training, from 71.9 % 71.9\% to 83.3 % 83.3\% on V* and from 69.3 % 69.3\% to 73.5 % 73.5\% on HR-Bench 4K, while the model invokes tool frequently.
However, the model increasingly claims to see the target regardless of whether it is present: FNR decreases from 24.6 % 24.6\% to 0 % 0\% , while FPR increases from 51.7 % 51.7\% to 100 % 100\% By the end of training, the model claims to see the target in every first crop, even when the crop misses it completely.
blocks.zh:
为了追踪这种不匹配的发展,我们复制了DeepEyes培训,并跟踪检查点的业绩(图3)。
值得注意的是,该模型的无工具精度在工具强化培训期间大幅提升,在V*上从71.9%的71.9%,上升到83.3%的83.3%;在HR-Bench 4K上从69.3%的69.3%,上升到73.5%的73.5%;而该模型经常引用工具。
然而,该模型越来越多地声称,无论目标是否存在,都要看到目标:FNR从24.6% 24.6 %下降到了0% 0 %;FPR从51.7% 51.7 %上升到了100% 100 % 在训练结束时,模型声称在每一头作物中都会看到目标,即使作物完全错过.

blocks.en:
These observations show that higher accuracy does not imply more faithful use of the returned evidence: during training, accuracy without tools rises while the model’s claims about the returned crops become less faithful, and the trained model gains little from tool use.
These results suggest that many questions can be answered correctly without zooming, and the model needs zooming for fewer questions as training proceeds.
The model can correctly answer such questions even if it ignores the zoomed crop, so training does not require the model to use the crop faithfully.
This leads us to hypothesise that unfaithful tool use may stem from training questions that do not require zooming.
Supervising where to crop may not solve this problem, as CodeV is explicitly rewarded for zooming into the target region but still has a high FNR.
If this hypothesis holds, we can improve faithfulness by specifying an appropriate training curriculum.
Since the model’s accuracy without tools improves during training, we select training questions for which the correct zoomed evidence helps the current model answer correctly ( Section 3.2 ).
Measuring this benefit requires annotated evidence regions, which is provided by our data synthesis pipeline ( Section 3.1 ).
blocks.zh:
这些观察表明,更高的准确性并不意味着更忠实地使用返回的证据:在训练期间,没有工具的准确性上升了,而模型对返回的作物的主张则不那么忠实了,经过训练的模型从工具使用中得益甚微.
这些结果表明,许多问题可以在不放大的情况下得到正确回答,而模型需要随着培训的进行而缩小问题。
模型即使忽略了被放大的收成,也可以正确回答这样的问题,因此训练不需要模型忠实地使用收成.
这导致我们假设,不忠的工具使用可能源于不需要放大的训练问题.
监督在哪里收成可能无法解决这个问题,因为CodeV因为放大到目标区域而得到明确的奖励,但FNR仍然很高.
如果这一假设成立,我们可以通过规定适当的培训课程提高忠诚度。
由于模型的准确性在培训期间没有工具,因此我们选择了训练问题,而正确的放大证据有助于当前模型正确回答(第3.2节)。
衡量这一效益需要附加说明的证据区域,由我们的数据综合管道提供(第3.1节)。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We train the policy on questions where zoomed evidence improves answer accuracy.
In this section, we first introduce our visual search data synthesis method ( Section 3.1 ).
We then introduce our data selection method, which identifies the questions that the current policy answers more accurately with the ground-truth evidence crops than with the whole image alone ( Section 3.2 ).
We also reward correct direct answers when the sampled trajectories indicate that the question can be answered without zooming ( Section 3.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们训练政策的问题 放大的证据 提高答案的准确性。
在本节中,我们首先介绍我们的视觉搜索数据合成方法(第3.1节)。
然后,我们开始采用我们的数据选择方法,确定当前政策在地面证据作物方面比整个图像更准确地回答的问题(第3.2节)。
如果抽样的轨迹表明问题可以不缩放地回答,我们也奖励正确的直接回答(第3.3节)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual-search Data Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.1 视觉搜索数据综合

blocks.en:
We aim to generate questions that are challenging to answer from the whole image alone without zooming.
As shown in Figure 4 , the synthesis has three stages.
We first locate small objects in each high-resolution image, with image sources given in Section 4.1 .
A question generator then uses crops of these objects and their surroundings to write questions about object attributes and spatial relations.
Finally, we verify that each question refers to an identifiable target, has an answer supported by the image, and cannot be guessed from the question alone.
More details of data synthesis are provided in Appendix C and Appendix F .

最后,我们核实每个问题指的是一个可识别的目标,有图像支持的答案,不能单从问题中猜出.

blocks.en:
Target identification. Several objects may match a question’s description, making its intended target ambiguous.
We check if the question is ambiguous using Set-of-Mark prompting [ 50 ] .
Specifically, we mark SAM3-identified objects in the surrounding image region with numbered boxes and ask the question generator to select every object that matches the question’s intended target. If the generator does not select exactly the intended target, we ask it to revise the question using the target’s relative location or nearby landmarks, without leaking its absolute position. We then verify the revised question and reject it if the intended target still cannot be uniquely identified.

To encourage the model to base its answers on visual evidence, we construct additional unanswerable examples by obscuring the regions needed to answer each question. blocks.en: 3.3 Adaptiveness reward for selection

blocks.en:
Because selection relies on the policy’s tool-free accuracy, it can underestimate what the policy is able to answer from the whole image when the policy rarely answers directly and almost always invokes the tool.
To address this, we add an adaptiveness reward that favours correct tool-free answers on questions the policy can already answer reliably without tools. This makes the tool-free accuracy a more faithful estimate of what the policy can answer without zooming.

为了解决这一问题,我们增加了一个适应性奖励,它有利于在没有工具的情况下对政策已经可以可靠地回答的问题作出正确的无工具的答案。 这使得无工具的准确性更忠实地估计了政策在不放大的情况下能够回答什么问题.

The adaptiveness reward and selection work together: the reward keeps the policy answering without tools when it can, so that its accuracy without tools reflects what it can see in the whole image, and selection uses this accuracy to select questions where the ground-truth crops can help.
They are intended to adapt the training data to the model’s evolving capability during training.

blocks.en:
For RL training, we use our data synthesis workflow ( Section 3.1 ) to construct 13K visual-search questions on high-resolution images from CC12M [ 5 ] , SA-1B [ 14 ] , InfographicVQA [ 24 ] , Wikimedia Commons [ 46 ] , VisDrone [ 62 ] , TinyPerson [ 52 ] , Unsplash [ 38 ] , DOTA [ 48 ] , DocVQA [ 23 ] , SKU-110K [ 6 ] , and xView [ 16 ] .
Of these questions, 67.5 % 67.5\% are single-object questions, 25.0 % 25.0\% are spatial-relation questions, and 7.5 % 7.5\% are unanswerable questions, and Table 8 presents their distribution across abilities.
Before RL, we apply SFT for a cold start so that the policy learns the tool-call format and how to reason about a returned crop.
We construct 1K SFT examples from questions produced by our data synthesis method.
Each example shows one of four behaviours: answering directly from the whole image, zooming into the ground-truth crop and then answering, recovering after a first zoom that misses the target, or searching several regions before concluding that the question is unanswerable.
More details of the RL and SFT data are provided in Appendices C and D .

We evaluate visual search and fine-grained perception on six benchmarks: V* [ 47 ] , HR-Bench 4K and 8K [ 42 ] , the English and Chinese splits of MME-RealWorld [ 57 ] , and ZoomBench [ 45 ] .
We further assess faithfulness on four multimodal hallucination benchmarks: RePOPE [ 20 , 25 ] , AMBER [ 41 ] , HaloQuest [ 43 ] , and VizWiz [ 8 ] . In the main paper, we compare baselines initialised from Qwen2.5-VL-7B: DeepEyes [ 61 ] , PixelReasoner [ 33 ] , Thyme [ 58 ] , DeepEyesV2 [ 9 ] , Mini-o3 [ 15 ] , Adaptive CoF [ 56 ] , PyVision-Image [ 59 ] , CodeV [ 10 ] , and ZwZ [ 45 ] .

We use Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 2 ] as the main base model because most existing TwI models are built on it, allowing us to analyse and compare the faithfulness and performance more effectively.
Results based on Qwen3-VL-4B [ 36 ] and Qwen3.5-4B [ 27 ] are reported in Section E.3 . SFT runs for one epoch (32 steps) with a batch size of 32 and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} .

During both training and inference, we allow up to eight interaction turns, i.e., K = 8 K=8 in Equation 1 . More training and inference details are provided in Appendix D .

As shown in Table 2 , FaithTwI achieves the highest accuracy compared to strong baselines on V*, HR-Bench, and ZoomBench. On V*, it reaches 90.1 % 90.1\% , matching Adaptive CoF and at least 1.4 % 1.4\% higher than the other baselines.
HR-Bench and ZoomBench further evaluate fine-detail perception in high-resolution images. Our model achieves 79.5 % 79.5\% on HR-Bench 4K, 77.3 % 77.3\% on HR-Bench 8K, and 56.8 % 56.8\% on ZoomBench, improving over the strongest baselines by 1.4 % 1.4\% , 3.0 % 3.0\% , and 1.2 % 1.2\% , respectively.
On MME-RealWorld, FaithTwI achieves comparable accuracy to ZwZ-7B.
The largest gain occurs on HR-Bench 8K, suggesting that the zooming is particularly useful when process higher-resolution images.

blocks.en:
The target recognition audit in Section 2.1 shows that FaithTwI achieves 94.5 % 94.5\% target-recognition accuracy, with 8.7 % 8.7\% FNR and 2.2 % 2.2\% FPR.
To investigate whether faithful target recognition also extends to answer accuracy, we further evaluate on the multimodal hallucination benchmarks RePOPE, AMBER, HaloQuest, and VizWiz.
As shown in Table 5 , our model outperforms DeepEyes and CodeV on all four benchmarks and achieves the highest scores among the listed models on HaloQuest and VizWiz, exceeding CodeV by 8.5 % 8.5\% and 2.2 % 2.2\% , respectively.
PixelReasoner achieves comparable accuracy compared to FaithTwI on RePOPE and AMBER but much lower on HaloQuest and VizWiz.

为了调查忠实的目标识别是否也包括答案准确性,我们进一步评估了多模式幻觉基准RePOPE、AMBER、HaloQuest和VizWiz。
如表5所示,我们的模型在所有四个基准上都超过了DeepEyes和CodeV,并在HaloQuest和VizWiz上列出的模型中取得了最高的分数,分别超过CodeV的8.5%.8.5%.和2.2 %.2%.。
PixelReasoner在RePOPE和AMBER上与FaithTwI相比实现了可比较的精确度,但在HaloQuest和VizWiz上则要低得多.

blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和讨论

blocks.en: We examine how data selection, the adaptiveness reward, synthesised questions, and tool access during training affect accuracy and visual-evidence use. Starting from the same SFT checkpoint, we train models without selection (w/o selection), without the adaptiveness reward (w/o adapt. reward), and without either component (w/o selection & adapt. reward). We also replace the synthesised training dataset with DeepEyes questions (w/o synthesised data) or remove tool access during RL (w/o tool training). More implementation details are described in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 我们研究数据选择、适应性奖励、综合问题和在培训期间使用工具如何影响准确性和视觉证据的使用。 从同一个SFT检查站开始,我们训练模型时不进行选择(w/o选择),不进行适应性奖励(w/o适应.奖励),也不进行任何组成部分(w/o选择和适应.奖励). 我们还用DeepEyes问题(w/o合成数据)取代了综合培训数据集,或在RL(w/o工具培训)期间去除工具访问. 附录D叙述了更多执行细节。

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 5 (left), without data selection, tool use falls below 1 % 1\% by step 24, and without synthesized data, it falls below 1 % 1\% by step 13. In contrast, removing the adaptiveness reward (w/o adapt. reward) or both selection and the reward (w/o sel. & adapt. reward) keeps tool use at 99.4 % 99.4\% and 98.3 % 98.3\% at the end of training, compared with 88.8 % 88.8\% for the full method.
This indicates that selection helps maintain tool use when the adaptiveness reward encourages correct direct answers, while the adaptiveness reward slightly lowers the tool-use rate.
The collapse of tool use without selection hurts fine-grained perception. As shown in Table 3 , removing selection alone lowers accuracy on HR-Bench 8K to 71.5 % 71.5\% , compared with 77.3 % 77.3\% for the full method, because the model no longer invokes the tool to inspect fine-grained regions of the high-resolution image. Removing both selection and the reward gives a similar 71.9 % 71.9\% .
blocks.zh:
如图5(左)所示,如果不选择数据,工具使用率按步骤24下降至1%.1%.;如不综合数据,按步骤13下降至1%.1%.。 相形之下,取消适应性奖励(w/o reform. reference. reference)或者同时取消选择和奖励(w/o sel. 适应.奖励)将工具使用率保持在99.4% 99.4% 99.4% 98.3% 98.3% 98.3% 培训结束时,而全方法使用率为88.8% 88.8% 。
这表明,在适应性奖励鼓励正确的直接答案时,选择有助于保持工具的使用,而适应性奖励略微地降低了工具使用率.
工具使用不经过选择而崩溃会伤害到精致的感知. 如表3所示,仅删除选取量将HR-Bench 8K的精度降至71.5% 71.5\%,而全方法的精度为77.3% 77.3\%,因为模型不再使用工具来检查高分辨率图像的精细区域. 取消选择和奖励给予71.9%的类似报酬。

blocks.en:
We compare faithfulness among the models that continue to use tools: the full method, the model without the adaptiveness reward, and the model without both selection and the reward.
As shown in Table 4 , the full method achieves a crop-recognition accuracy of 94.5 % 94.5\% , compared with 92.6 % 92.6\% without the adaptiveness reward and 91.9 % 91.9\% without both components. Table 5 shows that the full method obtains the highest score on all four multimodal hallucination benchmarks. For example, on HaloQuest, it reaches 70.7 % 70.7\% , compared with 56.7 % 56.7\% without the reward and 62.0 % 62.0\% without both components. Selection without the adaptiveness reward does not consistently improve these scores. These results indicate that adaptive data selection and the adaptiveness reward jointly improve faithfulness.
blocks.zh:
我们比较继续使用工具的模型中的忠实性:全方法,没有适应性奖励的模型,没有选择和奖励的模型.
如表4所示,整个方法的作物识别精度为94.5%,而92.6%的作物识别精度没有适应性奖励,91.9%的作物识别精度没有两种成分。 表5显示,全方法在所有四个多模式幻觉基准上都获得了最高分. 例如,在HaloQuest上,这一比率达到70.7%,而56.7%为56.7%,没有奖励;62.0%为62.0%,没有两种成分。 没有适应性奖励的选拔并不能持续地提高这些分数. 这些结果表明,适应性数据选择和适应性奖励共同提高了忠诚度。

blocks.en:
We examine tool use in two settings: 1) we evaluate FaithTwI with and without tool access at inference time ( Figure 5 , right); 2) we compare FaithTwI with the model without tools during RL training (w/o tool training) ( Table 3 ). The first comparison measures the benefit of tools at inference, and the second comparison isolates the benefit of training on our dataset without the tool.
At inference, tool access initially lowers HR-Bench 8K accuracy from 68.8 % 68.8\% to 62.4 % 62.4\% , but the final model gives 77.3 % 77.3\% with tools and 71.5 % 71.5\% without them. Thus, the trained model benefits from using tools beyond what it can answer directly. The model trained and evaluated without tools reaches 70.6 % 70.6\% on HR-Bench 8K and 51.0 % 51.0\% on ZoomBench, below the full method’s 77.3 % 77.3\% and 56.8 % 56.8\% .
These two results demonstrate that tool use improves accuracy rather than being decorative.
blocks.zh:
我们审查两种情况下的工具用途: 1)我们评价FaithTwI在推论时间有无工具访问(图5,右;2),我们将FaithTwI与模型进行比较,在RL训练期间没有工具(w/o工具训练)(表3). 第一次比较在推断时衡量工具的效益,第二次比较在没有工具的情况下隔离了对我们的数据集进行培训的好处。
推论,工具访问最初将HR-Bench 8K的精度从68.8% 68.8\%降至62.4% 62.4\%,但最终模型给出了77.3% 77.3\%有工具,71.5% 71.5\%没有工具. 因此,经过培训的模型从使用超出其直接答复能力的工具中受益。 在没有工具的情况下训练和评估的模型在HR-Bench 8K上达到70.6%,在Zomo Bench上达到51.0%,低于全方法的77.3% 77.3 %和56.8% 56.8 %。
这两个结果表明,工具的使用提高了准确性而不是装饰性.

blocks.en: Replacing our synthesised training dataset with DeepEyes training data (w/o synthesised data) leads to almost no tool use during training and reduces accuracy to 69.0 % 69.0\% on HR-Bench 8K and 49.5 % 49.5\% on ZoomBench, compared with 77.3 % 77.3\% and 56.8 % 56.8\% for the full method. It also omits data selection because the data lack the evidence-region annotations needed to estimate the benefit of zoomed evidence specified in Equation 2 . Thus, it combines synthesised questions with evidence regions that enable selection, rather than isolating question synthesis alone; instead, without selection ablation (w/o selection) shows the effectiveness of data selection.
blocks.zh: 用DeepEyes培训数据(w/o合成数据)取代我们的综合培训数据集,导致在培训期间几乎不使用任何工具,并将精确度降低到HR-Bench 8K的69.0%和Zoom Bench的49.5%,而全方法的精确度分别为77.3%、77.3%和56.8%。 它还省略了数据选择,因为数据缺乏估计第2款所指明的放大证据的好处所需的证据区域说明。 因此,它把综合问题与能够进行选择的证据区域结合起来,而不是孤立问题合成;相反,不进行选择(w/o选择),则显示数据选择的有效性。

blocks.en:
As shown in Table 4 , FPR increases to 96.3 % 96.3\% without SFT, compared with 2.2 % 2.2\% for the full method.
Removing SFT also reduces HaloQuest accuracy from 70.7 % 70.7\% to 34.2 % 34.2\% and VizWiz accuracy from 57.1 % 57.1\% to 45.0 % 45.0\% ( Table 5 ).
These results suggest that SFT provides an important starting point; starting from the SFT model, data selection and the adaptiveness reward improve accuracy and faithfulness effectively.
CodeV [ 10 ] uses 333K SFT examples, whereas FaithTwI uses only 1K examples for one epoch, showing that lightweight SFT is necessary and sufficient.
blocks.zh:
如表4所示,无SFT的FPR增长到96.3%96.3%,而全方法为2.2% 2.2%.。
移除 SFT 还将光学精度从 70.7% 70.7 % 降至 34.2% 34.2 % 和 VizWiz 的精度从 57.1% 57.1 % 降至 45.0% 45.0 % 。 (表5) (单位:千美元)
这些结果表明,SFT提供了一个重要的起点;从SFT模型开始,数据选择和适应性奖励有效地提高了准确性和忠诚性.
代码 [10] 使用333K SFT 示例,而 FaithTw 我对一个时代只使用1K个例子,表明轻量级SFT是必要和足够的.

blocks.en: To test whether our method transfers to other base models, we also apply it to Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking [ 1 ] and Qwen3.5-4B [ 27 ] , with the same training settings. As shown in Figure 6 , FaithTwI reaches 80.8 % 80.8\% on HR-Bench 8K and 66.3 % 66.3\% on ZoomBench with Qwen3-VL-4B, 84.5 % 84.5\% and 66.4 % 66.4\% with Qwen3.5-4B. Comparisons with other models based on Qwen3-VL-4B and Qwen3.5-4B are presented in Section E.3 .

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
VLMs often miss small objects and fine spatial details in high-resolution, information-dense images. Thinking with images addresses this by letting the model crop and zoom into regions during reasoning, a paradigm popularised by OpenAI o3 [ 26 ] . PixelReasoner [ 33 ] , DeepEyes [ 61 ] , Chain-of-Focus [ 56 ] , ViGoRL [ 30 ] , and Mini-o3 [ 15 ] train VLMs to use crop-and-zoom tools with RL, and Thyme [ 58 ] , CodeV [ 10 ] , PyVision-RL [ 59 ] , and DeepEyesV2 [ 9 ] extend the tools to code execution and search. Another line of work removes the tool at inference time by distilling from zoomed images [ 45 , 53 ] .
Unlike distillation, which hides zooming at inference, explicit zooming shows which region an answer is based on. This is useful only if the model faithfully uses the zoomed region, which is what we study in this work.
blocks.zh:
VLM在高分辨率,信息密集的图像中经常会错过小物体和细微的空间细节. 用图像来思考,通过让模型作物在推理过程中放大到区域来解决这个问题,这个范例由OpenAI o3[26]所普及. PixelReasoner [33], DeepEyes [61], Chain-Focus [56], ViGORL [30], 和Mini-o3 [15] 列车 VLM 使用有 RL 的收割和分解工具, Thyme [58], CodeV [10], PyVision-RL [59], 和 DeepEyesV2 [9] 将工具扩展为代码执行和搜索. 另一行工作通过从被放大的图像中分馏[45,53],在推断时间去除工具.
与在推想中隐藏了放大的分馏不同,显式分出一个答案所依据的哪个区域. 这只有在模型忠实地使用被放大的区域时才有用,这就是我们在这项工作中研究的内容.

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought explanations can misrepresent what drives a prediction [ 37 , 17 ] , and recent work finds a similar gap for visual tools: most of the gains from tool-use RL come from intrinsic capability rather than from the returned images [ 21 , 7 , 31 ] . Other studies test whether the visual evidence changes the answer [ 44 , 54 , 19 ] , whereas we analyse how models respond to correct and wrong crops.
Some prior works supervise reasoning process to improve faithful visual tool use [ 10 , 39 , 51 ] . Other work filters data by tool benefit before training [ 61 , 9 , 40 , 22 , 49 ] . We instead improve faithfulness through data synthesis and selection with outcome-level rewards, estimating the benefit of zoomed evidence during training.
blocks.zh:
思维链解释可以歪曲是什么驱动了预测[37,17],而最近的工作在视觉工具上也发现了类似的空白:工具使用RL的大部分收益来自内在能力,而不是从返回的图像[21,7,31]. 其他研究测试视觉证据是否改变答案[44,54,19],而我们分析模型如何应对正确和错误的收成.
一些前作监督推理过程,以改善忠实视觉工具的使用[10,39,51]. 其他工作在培训前通过工具过滤数据[61、9、40、22、49]。 相反,我们通过数据综合和选择以及结果层面的奖励,估计训练期间放大证据的好处,提高了忠诚度。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
Through a target recognition analysis, we find that TwI models are often unfaithful to the images returned by the tool.
We trace this behaviour to training data on which zooming does not improve accuracy. To address this, we synthesise challenging questions, select training data according to the policy’s evolving capability, and reward correct tool-free trajectories. Experimental results show that FaithTwI improves both accuracy and faithfulness.
blocks.zh:
通过目标识别分析,我们发现TwI模型往往不忠于工具回放的图像.
我们追踪这种行为是训练数据,而放大不能提高准确性。 为了解决这个问题,我们综合了挑战性的问题,根据政策不断发展的能力选择培训数据,并奖励正确的无工具轨迹。 实验结果显示,FaithTwI既提高了准确度,也提高了忠诚度.

blocks.en: Section 4.1 lists the image sources. Most questions use images from CC12M [ 5 ] ( 52.3 % 52.3\% ) and SA-1B [ 14 ] ( 31.5 % 31.5\% ). Images that appear in our validation or test sets are excluded from training.

blocks.en: We use images whose longer side is at least 1,000 pixels. We split each image into tiles of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels, with a 25 % 25\% overlap between neighbouring tiles. For each tile, the question generator lists the visible object types, and SAM3 [ 4 ] localises objects of these types in the tile ( Section 3.1 ). We map the boxes back to the original image, keep those with a SAM3 confidence of at least 0.75, and merge duplicate boxes from overlapping tiles. We keep objects whose box is at most 64 × 64 64\times 64 pixels and does not touch the image boundary, since a cut-off object may not determine the answer. Each ground-truth crop contains the object box and its surroundings; near the image boundary, the crop window is shifted inward rather than clipped, so that it keeps its full size.
blocks.zh: 我们使用的图像,其更长的一面至少是1000像素. 我们把每个图像分成1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素的平面砖,相邻的平面砖相重叠25% 25. 对于每块瓷砖,问题生成器列出可见对象类型,而SAM3 [4]在瓷砖中将这些类型对象定位(第3.1节. 我们把盒子映射回原始图像,保留至少0.75个SAM3置信度的盒子,并从相重叠的瓷砖上将相重复的盒子合并. 我们保留其盒子最多为64×64 64\times 64像素的物体,不触摸图像边界,因为被截取的物体可能无法决定答案. 每个地面真实的收成都包含对象盒及其周围;在图像边界附近,收成窗口被向内移出,而不是被剪接出,这样它就能保持其全尺寸.

blocks.en: For a spatial-relation question, we take a 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 -pixel window centred on the box of the first object, shifted inward at the image boundary and limited to the image size. The question generator chooses the second object among the localised objects whose boxes lie entirely inside this window, and both objects satisfy the same size limit. The question refers to both objects only by their descriptions.
blocks.zh: 对于一个空间-关系问题,我们取取一个1920×1080 1920\times 1080-像素窗口,以第一个物体的盒子为中心,在图像边界向内转并限于图像大小. 问题生成器在被定位的物体中选择第二个对象,其盒子完全位于这个窗口内,两个对象都满足了相同的大小限制. 问题只涉及两个物体的描述。

blocks.en: We construct unanswerable questions from verified open-ended synthesised questions by obscuring their evidence region: we blur it, paste a patch from the same image over it, or fill it with grey. The whole image and every crop are then taken from the edited image, so the evidence cannot be recovered by zooming. We keep an edited question as unanswerable, with the answer cannot be determined , only if it passes two checks: the question generator judges that the answer can no longer be determined from the edited image, and the current policy cannot answer correctly to the original answer given the edited image and the edited evidence crop. We also apply the same kinds of edits to a region away from the evidence of other questions, which keep their original answers. Unanswerable questions are not filtered by the selection criterion in Equation 2 .
blocks.zh: 我们通过模糊其证据区域来构建无法回答的问题:我们模糊其证据区域,从同一图像上粘贴一个补丁,或者用灰色填充。 整个图像和每个收成随后从被编辑的图像中取出,因此无法通过缩放来取出证据. 我们保留一个经编辑的问题作为无法回答的问题,只有通过两次检查才能确定答案:问题生成者判断,无法再从被编辑的图像中确定答案,根据被编辑的图像和被编辑的证据收录,当前政策无法正确回答原始答案. 我们还对一个远离其他问题证据的区域进行同样的编辑,以保留其原始答案。 未解答的问题不会被"方程式2"中的选择标准所过滤.

blocks.en: Each batch contains 384 questions, including 16 unanswerable questions and 16 answerable questions whose images are edited away from the evidence. blocks.en: We use Qwen3.8-27B [ 28 ] as the question generator and Qwen-Flash-Next [ 29 ] as the judge that compares answers with references. We resize the image to at most 10240 visual tokens and each crop to at most 2048 visual tokens. We use SGLang [ 60 ] for inference with greedy decoding. The ablation models use the same settings, except where removing a component requires a change.

blocks.en: Before RL, SFT teaches the policy the tool-call format and how to reason about each returned crop. Each SFT example is a complete multi-turn conversation built from a synthesised question with an answer and its evidence boxes ( Section 3.1 ). The examples cover four behaviours: • Direct answer. The model answers from the whole image without zooming, either with the tool available or with no tool offered. • Zoom and answer. The model zooms into the evidence region, or into the regions of both objects for a spatial-relation question, and answers. • Recovery. The first zoom misses the target, for example by landing next to it or on a featureless region. The model notices that the target is not in the crop, zooms into the correct region, and answers. • Unanswerable question. The evidence needed to answer is not in the image. The model inspects two or three regions, or the whole image when no tool is offered, before stating that the answer cannot be determined. To decide between a direct answer and zooming, we ask the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct each answerable question four times with the whole image. We use the questions it answers correctly three or four times to build direct-answer examples, and the questions it answers correctly at most once to build zooming examples.
blocks.zh: 在RL之前,SFT教政策使用工具调用格式以及如何解释每个返回的收成. 每个SFT的例子都是从一个附有答案的合成问题及其证据框(第3.1节)所构建的完整的多回合对话. 例子包括四种行为: 直接回答。 模型从整个图像中解答,没有缩放,要么是可用工具,要么是没有提供工具. • 放大并回答。 模型放大到证据区域,或放大到两个物体的区域,以便提出空间关系问题和答案。 • 恢复。 第一个缩放错过了目标,例如降落在目标旁边或一个无地貌的区域. 该模型注意到目标不在收成中,放大到正确的区域,并给出答案. • 无法回答的问题。 答案所需要的证据不在图像中。 该模型检查了两到三个区域,或者在没有提供工具时检查整个图像,然后声明答案无法确定. 为了在直接回答和缩放之间作出决定,我们用整个图像向基座Quen2.5-VL-7B-指示每个可回答的问题四次. 我们用它正确回答的问题三到四次来构建直接回答的例子,而它最多一次正确回答的问题来构建放大的例子.

blocks.en: Direct answer. The model answers from the whole image without zooming, either with the tool available or with no tool offered.
blocks.zh: 直接回答问题。 模型从整个图像中解答,没有缩放,要么是可用工具,要么是没有提供工具.

blocks.en: Zoom and answer. The model zooms into the evidence region, or into the regions of both objects for a spatial-relation question, and answers.
blocks.zh: 放大并答. 模型放大到证据区域,或放大到两个物体的区域,以便提出空间关系问题和答案。

blocks.en: Recovery. The first zoom misses the target, for example by landing next to it or on a featureless region. The model notices that the target is not in the crop, zooms into the correct region, and answers.
blocks.zh: 复苏。 第一个缩放错过了目标,例如降落在目标旁边或一个无地貌的区域. 该模型注意到目标不在收成中,放大到正确的区域,并给出答案.

blocks.en: Unanswerable question. The evidence needed to answer is not in the image. The model inspects two or three regions, or the whole image when no tool is offered, before stating that the answer cannot be determined.
blocks.zh: 不可答之问. 答案所需要的证据不在图像中。 该模型检查了两到三个区域,或者在没有提供工具时检查整个图像,然后声明答案无法确定.

blocks.en:
We describe how we synthesise each category of the example in the following.
In a zooming example, the assistant’s zoom call requests the ground-truth crop of the question; in a recovery example, the first call requests a wrong region, next to the target or on a featureless area. We run the zoom tool on these calls, so every returned crop is a real crop of the image. The judge model then writes the assistant’s reasoning around these crops, given three hand-checked examples of the same behaviour as references. After each crop, the reasoning first describes what the crop shows, then states whether the target is fully, partly, or not visible, and finally answers or chooses another region. The judge model checks each reply against its crop; a reply that fails the check is rewritten, and the example is dropped if the rewrite also fails. We also check samples of each behaviour by hand against their images.

We use published scores where available and evaluate the remaining cells with each model’s own prompt, tool, and inference settings. AXPO-4B has no released weights, so only its published scores are listed. As shown in Table 10 , FaithTwI achieves the highest accuracy on five of the six benchmarks: V* ( 94.6 % 94.6\% ), HR-Bench 8K ( 80.8 % 80.8\% ), MME-RealWorld English ( 68.7 % 68.7\% ) and Chinese ( 68.6 % 68.6\% ), and ZoomBench ( 66.3 % 66.3\% ), where it exceeds the strongest baseline, ZwZ-4B, by 10.6 10.6 points. blocks.en: E.4 Human Evaluation
blocks.zh: E.4 人类评价

blocks.en: We conduct a human evaluation to verify the automatic judge used in Section 2.1 and to examine how the models behave when the first crop does not contain the target. Four annotators labelled the response right after the first zoom, where the returned image is the model’s own crop, a ground-truth crop centred on the target, a random crop, a grey image, or a black image. Without knowing the model or the image type, they labelled whether the image shows the target, whether the model says that the target is in the image, and, if the image does not show the target, what the model does next. Each annotator labelled 192 samples, 32 of which were shared by all annotators, giving 672 distinct samples.
blocks.zh: 我们进行一项人类评估,以核实第2.1节中使用的自动判断器,并审查第一作物没有目标时模型的表现。 四个注释者在第一个缩放之后就标出反应, 返回的图像是模型自己的收成, 以目标为中心的地面真实收成, 随机收成, 灰色图像, 或是黑色图像。 在不知道模型或图像类型的情况下,他们标出图像是否显示目标,模型是否表示目标在图像中,如果图像不显示目标,模型接下来会做什么. 每个注释者标出192个样本,其中32个样本由所有注释者共享,给出了672个不同的样本.

blocks.en: On the shared samples, Fleiss’ kappa is 0.89 0.89 for whether the image shows the target and 0.79 0.79 for whether the model claims the target. Annotators agree on every sample with a replaced image, as in the controlled setting used in Section 2.1 ; all disagreements occur on the models’ own crops, as in the real-crop setting ( Appendix A ), where the target may be only partly presented. On replaced images, the judge agrees with the human labels on 95.6 % 95.6\% of samples (Cohen’s kappa 0.91 0.91 ; Table 11 ), which supports the judge-based results in Section 2.1 . On the models’ own crops, the judge is less reliable at deciding whether the crop shows the target (Cohen’s kappa 0.44 0.44 ), which is why the main paper uses the controlled setting.
blocks.zh: 在共享样本上,Fleiss的kappa表示图像是否显示目标为0.89 0.89,模型是否声称目标为0.79 0.79. 注释者就每个取而代之的图像样本达成一致,如第2.1节所使用的控制环境;所有分歧都发生在模型本身的作物上,如在实际作物环境中(附录A),目标只能部分提出。 在替换的图像上,法官同意95.6%的样本(Cohen的kapa 0.91.0.91;表11)的人类标签,该标签支持第2.1节基于法官的结果。 在模型本身的作物上,法官在判断作物是否显示目标(Cohen's kappa 0.44 0.44)时不太可靠,这就是主要纸张使用受控环境的原因.

blocks.en: When the image shows a wrong region, FaithTwI notices that the target is not in image and zooms again in 92.4 % 92.4\% of cases, and it does so for every grey or black image ( Table 12 ). DeepEyes and PixelReasoner instead continue as if the target were present in 85.3 % 85.3\% – 100 % 100\% of these cases. CodeV also zooms again, but it does so even when the crop contains the target (FNR 84.5 % 84.5\% ), so its retries do not show that it has checked the image.
blocks.zh: 当图像显示错误区域时,FaithTwI注意到目标不在图像中,在92.4%的92.4%的病例中再次缩放,每张灰色或黑色图像都缩放(表12). DepEyes 和 PixelReasoner 转而将目标延续到85.3%的85.3% — — 100%的100 % 。 CodeV也再次缩放,但即使收成包含目标(FNR 84.5% 84.5\%),它也会这样做,所以它的回放没有显示它检查了图像.

blocks.en: FaithTwI never states that the question is unanswerable directly after a crop that misses the target; it does so only after zooming again. On its own crops that miss the target, it zooms again and then states that the question is unanswerable in 48.5 % 48.5\% of cases, which may happen when its later zooms also fail to find the target. On replaced images, only the first crop is replaced, so its next zoom returns a real crop of the image, where it usually finds the target and answers. It therefore states that the question is unanswerable on only 4.2 % 4.2\% of random crops and never on grey or black images.
blocks.zh: FaithTwI从未声明这个问题在作物错过了目标后是无法直接回答的;它只是在再次放大后才这样做. 在它自己错过了目标的作物上,它再次放大,然后表示在48.5%的48.5%的病例中,这个问题是无法回答的,而当它的后期放大也未能找到目标时,这个问题可能会发生. 在被替换的图像上,只有第一个收成被替换,因此其下个缩放返回图像的真实收成,通常在那里找到目标和答案. 因此,它指出,这个问题在4.2%的随机作物上是无法回答的,在灰色或黑色的图像上是永远无法回答的。

blocks.zh: E.5 在第一作物种植之前引出的答复

blocks.en: Section 2.1 and Section E.4 show that DeepEyes and PixelReasoner often respond as if the target were present, even when the returned crop does not contain it. Checking their outputs, we notice that models sometimes infer an answer in their first reasoning turn, before they call the tool. For example, for the question “What is the color of the cart?”, DeepEyes first writes “The cart in the image is green. I can see that the cart has a green body and green handles. Therefore, the correct answer is D. green.” and then calls the tool to zoom into a region. Thus, it has chosen its answer before it sees the crop, which may be one reason for its unfaithful responses.
blocks.zh: 第2.1节和E.4节显示,DeepEyes和PixelReasoner的反应往往仿佛目标存在,即使返回的作物并不包含它. 在检查它们的输出时,我们注意到模型有时会在它们的第一个推理回合中,在它们调用工具之前推断出一个答案. 例如,关于“车的颜色是什么?” 深眼先写 “形象中的推车是绿色的。 我可以看到,车有一个绿色的身体和绿色的把手。 因此,正确的答案是D. Green。” 然后将工具放大到一个区域。 因此,它在看到作物之前就选择了答案,这可能是它作出不忠反应的原因之一。

blocks.en:
To measure how often this happens, we use the judge to determine whether the first reasoning turn z 1 z_{1} states or clearly implies an answer. In a separate session, the judge checks whether this answer matches the model’s final prediction.
As shown in Table 13 , DeepEyes infers an answer before the crop for 88.0 % 88.0\% of questions, and its final prediction matches this answer for 95.2 % 95.2\% of them. In other words, DeepEyes has already decided its answer before it sees the crop in 83.7 % 83.7\% of cases. This supports the possible reason above for DeepEyes and agrees with the low attention it gives to the first crop ( Section E.6 ). These results do not explain the behaviour of PixelReasoner and CodeV, which infer an answer before the first crop for only 21.8 % 21.8\% and 8.2 % 8.2\% of questions, so their unfaithful responses could have other causes. FaithTwI infers an answer before the crop for 20.4 % 20.4\% of questions.

为了衡量这种情况的发生频率,我们利用法官来判断第一个推理转动为z 1 z_{1}是表示还是明确暗示一个答案. 法官在另一场比赛中检查这个答案是否符合模型的最终预测。
如表13所示,DeepEyes推断,88.0%的问题发生在作物之前,其最终预测与其中95.2%的问题吻合。 换句话说,DeepEyes已经在83.7%的案例中看到作物前决定了答案。 这证实了上文关于DeepEyes的可能理由,并同意它对第一作物的注意不够(E.6节)。 这些结果并不能解释PixelReasoner和CodeV的行为,它们推断出第一次收成前只有21.8%的21.8\%和8.2%的8.2%的提问答案,所以不忠的回答可能还有其他原因. 信仰图 我推断出20.4%的问题 在作物之前有个答案

blocks.en: E.6 Attention on the First Crop
blocks.zh: E.6 注意第一作物

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Proportion of attention over the input while the model writes its response after the first crop (%).
blocks.zh: 图8:在第一作物之后,模型编写答复时注意投入的比例(%)。

blocks.en: We analyse how each model distributes its attention over the context while it generates its response after the first crop. For each response token, we split its attention over all earlier tokens into six segments: the text before the image, the image, the question and the first assistant turn, the first crop, the text after the crop, and the earlier response tokens. We then average the proportions over all layers, attention heads, and response tokens, and then over the V* examples. As shown in Figure 8 , FaithTwI gives the first crop 7.7 % 7.7\% of its attention, compared with 6.0 % 6.0\% for PixelReasoner, 1.1 % 1.1\% for CodeV, and 0.7 % 0.7\% for DeepEyes. It also attends less to the question and its first turn, with 11.6 % 11.6\% compared with 18.3 % 18.3\% – 25.8 % 25.8\% for the baselines. These results suggest that FaithTwI relies more on the returned crop when it reasons after a zoom, which is consistent with its more faithful target recognition.
blocks.zh: 我们分析每个模型如何在第一作物后产生反应的同时,将注意力放在上下文中。 对于每个响应符,我们将其注意力分到所有早期的响应符上,分为六个部分:图像前的文本,图像,问题和第一个助手转出,第一个收成,收成后的文本,以及更早期的响应符. 然后,我们平均各层的比例,注意头和反应符号,然后是V*实例。 如图8所示,FaithTwI给予第一种作物7.7%的注意力,而PixelReasoner为6.0%;CodeV为1.1%;DeepEyes为0.7%. 与18.3%的18.3% — — 25.8%的25.8% — — 基线相比,它也不太关注问题及其第一次转向,11.6%为11.6%。 这些结果表明,FaithTwI在缩放后出现原因时更多地依赖还原作物,这与其更忠实的目标识别是一致的.

blocks.en: Design visual search questions: questions that require locating a target in an image and inspecting its details. The agent will receive an unannotated image and a question, and can use tools to inspect image details. Design questions that require close inspection of the selected region to answer. Write up to {num_questions} distinct questions supported by the evidence. Prefer different facts rather than paraphrases. Do not force different ability categories or invent facts to reach the requested count. If none of the allowed abilities fits this region, return {"questions": []} instead of changing the target or inventing a question. The attached images appear in this order: - Image 1: a detailed crop of the selected evidence region, enlarged when small and padded with white. Use the visible scene content to determine the answers; padding is not part of the scene. - Image 2: a larger context crop around the selected region. Use it to understand the surroundings. - Image 3: the whole image, resized, with the selected region outlined in red. Use it to identify the target within the full scene. Write clear, self-contained questions that identify the target in the full image without referring to crops or annotations. Do not hint at the answer. Provide a concise answer supported by visible details in the selected region. Before finalizing each question, inspect the whole image for other objects that fit its wording. If they could give different answers, add a visible position or nearby landmark that distinguishes the selected target without revealing the answer. Multiple matching objects are acceptable only when the requested answer is visibly the same for all of them; similar appearance alone is not enough. Omit the question if you cannot resolve conflicting or uncertain answers. Use the red outline only to locate the region; determine the object’s color and appearance from the unmarked detailed crop. For each question, label the main ability needed to answer it using only the following list. Omit questions that require an ability outside this list. Positional wording may locate the target, but questions about relationships between two objects are generated separately. - text_recognition: read visible text or symbols. - color_recognition: identify a visible color. - entity_recognition: identify an object or entity. - counting: count all visible items in a clearly defined group or area. - structure_recognition: identify shape, parts, arrangement, or a visible pattern. - material_recognition: identify what an object or part is made of when the material is visually distinguishable. Use broad material names; do not guess an exact composition or force a material question. Additional instructions: Each question is later checked against a small vision-language model: it is discarded if that model can answer it from the question text alone (for example the usual colour of such an object, an object whose name follows from a described shape or use, an obvious position), or from the whole image without zooming. That model sees the whole image at up to about 8 megapixels (about 3,300 x 2,400 pixels), so anything legible at that size is too easy: on documents, infographics and charts ask about the smallest print (fine print, footnotes, small labels, tiny numbers in a table or figure), never headings or normal body text; in photos ask about small or distant things. Ask about a detail that has to be seen up close and differs from picture to picture: printed text or numbers, a colour, pattern or material that is not the typical one for such an object, how many small items there are, or a fine part or marking. Refer to the target by where it is and what is around it, never by features that give the answer away. The image analysis model provided this region description for reference: {region_description} For every question, also write guess_without_image: the answer a person who cannot see the picture would most likely give from the question text and common sense. If that guess would be the same as the true answer, do not ask that question. Ask instead about a detail whose answer cannot be guessed: printed text or numbers, a colour, marking or pattern that is not the usual one for such an object, or how many small items there are. These question-answer examples illustrate the allowed abilities using other images. Do not copy their answers or assume their objects, text, numbers, or relationships exist in the current image. Use them as inspiration, not templates to copy. You may use any listed ability, including those without an example. Base each question and answer on the current evidence. If no allowed ability is suitable, return an empty questions list. {examples} Return JSON containing at most {num_questions} question objects, without Markdown fences: {"questions": [{"question": "...", "answer": "...", "ability": "one of the listed abilities", "guess_without_image": "the answer a person who cannot see the picture would most likely give"}]} Return fewer questions when the evidence supports fewer, or {"questions": []} when none are suitable.

blocks.en: Each question is later checked against a small vision-language model: it is discarded if that model can answer it from the question text alone (for example the usual colour of such an object, an object whose name follows from a described shape or use, an obvious position), or from the whole image without zooming.
